title: The 'Add Customer' button in the New Work Order flow when Customers Create & Edit is OFF
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Work orders Create & Edit ON, Customers View ON and Customers Create & Edit OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and click New Work Order.
  2. Go to the customer selection step.
  3. Look for an Add Customer button in the customer picker.
custom_expected:
The Add Customer button is not shown in the customer picker; the user can still pick an existing customer but cannot create a new one.

(Known deviation: a prior run found this button still appearing when Customers Create & Edit is off — recommend a live re-check.)
viu_status: Blocked-UI; prior run FAILED here (button still shown) — re-test live
evidence: RUN331 recorded C26387 as a FAILED deviation (Add Customer still shown with Customers C&E off).
